summary: Backend smoke tests for FanOps ERP: 23/24 checks passed. Auth (login/me/401), Department seeding + CRUD, Employee register (auto access_uid) + list/update/delete, non-admin 403 role checks, full CRUD for materials/leads/customers/suppliers/orders/budget, /upload base64, models create+list, AI assistant with Emergent LLM fallback (provider='Emergent LLM (fallback)'), assistant history, profile update, and change-password (wrong old => 400, correct old => 200) all working. Only one minor discrepancy: dashboard summary uses key 'low_stock_items' instead of expected 'low_stock' array (the KPI count 'low_stock' is present in kpis). Login response returns 'token' (not 'access_token') — noted, front-end should use 'token'.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin returns JWT + admin user (key: 'token')
GET /api/departments returns 4 seeded departments with custom_roles
POST /api/auth/register creates employee w/ auto access_uid
Non-admin gets 403 on POST /auth/register and POST /departments
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns kpis (all required fields) + recent_orders + recent_leads arrays
POST /api/assistant/chat falls back to Emergent LLM (provider='Emergent LLM (fallback)') and returns valid text (no crash)

failed.issue: Response uses 'low_stock_items' (array) instead of 'low_stock' as specified. The 'low_stock' key exists inside kpis as a count integer, which conflicts with an array-level 'low_stock' expectation. Front-end contract mismatch risk.
failed.evidence: Response: kpis.low_stock=0 (int); top-level has 'low_stock_items': [] but no 'low_stock' array.

action_items: Decide contract: either rename top-level 'low_stock_items' -> 'low_stock' (matches spec) OR update spec/frontend to consume 'low_stock_items'.
Note that /api/auth/login returns key 'token' (not 'access_token') — ensure frontend reads response.token.
